description_html: Greg talks to a caller about whether Colossians 1:15 implies that Jesus is part of creation since it says he is the “firstborn,” then he reflects on the first Christmas and the birth of Jesus.

title: If Jesus Is the Firstborn, Does That Mean He’s Part of Creation?
